$doc: Registry of the ChatGPT chats used for image generation, grouped by PURPOSE. Every image-gen script (repurpose/gen-images.js, gen-batch-freshchat.js, generate-broll-wlw.js, etc.) consults this via repurpose/chat-pool.js. A ChatGPT chat degrades past ~25 images (stops rendering OR returns off-prompt/style-contaminated images), so each chat is capped and auto-rotated. Chats are also keyed by purpose so different visual styles never share a chat and cross-contaminate. Flow: getActiveUrl(purpose) -> if a chat for that purpose has count<cap, reuse it; else the caller opens a fresh chatgpt.com/ chat, generates, captures the /c/<id> URL, and registerNewChat() replaces the full one. A replaced/dead chat is MOVED to the retired list and then DELETED in the ChatGPT UI (chats are disposable: every image is downloaded at generation time) -- the gen scripts sweep retired at end of run via chat-delete.js, and repurpose/delete-chats.js (spawned by cleanup/cleanup.js) sweeps leftovers. Optional per-chat batch = a batches.json id; when that batch is completed/archived, delete-chats.js retires+deletes the chat (no batch = evergreen purpose, rotation-only deletion; batch matching no batches.json entry = kept). recordImage(purpose) increments only on a SUCCESSFUL save. markDead(purpose) retires a chat that would not load (conversation-not-found) so a fresh one is made. TITLE CONVENTION (Mike 2026-07-22): confirmAndRegister() renames every automation chat at registration to start with "b-roll" (purposes containing broll) or "social" (all other image purposes); that live-title prefix is the ULTIMATE deletion gate — chat-delete.js refuses to delete any chat whose title does not start with b-roll/social (refusals recorded on title_gate_skipped). AUTO-TITLE RACE (2026-07-30): ChatGPT titles a new conversation asynchronously, and when that landed after the gated rename it silently overwrote it (chat showed e.g. 'Cinematic Trading Hall'); confirmAndRegister now waits out the auto-title before renaming, and sweepRetired first runs healTitles(), which re-renames any registry chat whose recorded gated `title` (verified-rename provenance = ours) no longer matches the live title, requeueing healed title_gate_skipped entries for deletion. Entries without that provenance are never touched. Registration is API-confirmed (real conversation id, never bare page.url()): the 2026-07 capture bug stored ids that 404d while real chats piled up unregistered; all dead entries were purged 2026-07-22 and every purpose re-seeds fresh on next use.
